name: Essence-honed Flesh (Akashic)
body:
Investing your own flesh with your essence allows you to hone your skin to act as a potent magical armament.

Prerequisite(s): Con 13 or veilweaver level 1

Benefit(s): Your unarmed strikes and natural attacks are always imbued with the remnants of your essence, allowing them to count as magical weapons for the purposes of bypassing damage reduction. Additionally, you can invest essence in this feat. For each point of essence invested, you gain a +1 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls with your unarmed strikes and natural attacks. Special: Unlike normal essence receptacles, this feat has its own essence capacity progression that cannot be increased or modified. Its essence capacity is 1 at character level 1, and increases by an additional 1 at character levels, 4, 8, 12, and 16. If an ability would allow you to invest essence in another receptacle in place of this feat, such as the Akashic Knowledge forbidden knowledge, that essence receptacle uses this essence capacity when interacting with this feat. If an ability would allow you to treat this feat as if it were invested with more essence, or allow you to bypass this feats essence capacity, its effects are limited to this feats essence capacity.

You gain 1 point of essence.
